Each difficulty saves its own progress and best score. Change it from the start screen, the ? card or the game-over card.
controls: Computer: click or drag across letters, or type them on the keyboard. Enter plays the word and Backspace deletes a letter.
Phone or tablet: tap letters or slide your finger from letter to letter, then tap Enter.
Hint shows the next letter of a good solution. Restart clears your words for this puzzle.
The sound button turns the sound effects on or off.
tips: Long words that use letters from all four sides get you there fastest.
Think about the last letter: a word ending in a common letter like S, E or T gives you more choices next.
Deleting the first letter of a word takes back your previous word, so you can try another path.
Save hints for the hard puzzles. You earn a new hint bulb every three puzzles you solve.
Under par pays the most: each word you save is worth 150 bonus points.
about: Letter Links is a word-chain puzzle with twelve chalk letters around a path in the park, three on each side. Each word you spell must hop between sides and must start with the last letter of the word before, and you win by turning every letter gold. Finish in par or fewer words for a bonus.

There are 72 hand-made puzzles across three difficulty levels. Beginner uses easy letters and a shorter list; Intermediate is the full run; Advanced brings in J, Q and Z with a four-letter minimum. It is a thinker's game that rewards a good vocabulary.

games.name: Sketch Sprint
games.tagline: Race a twisting sketchbook path through downtown, the backyard, the park, the creek and the woods. Swipe to turn, jump and slide.
games.meta: Play Sketch Sprint free online. A fast endless runner drawn in pencil. Pick Francis, Clare, George, Joan or one of four more kids and race a path that turns sharp corners through downtown, a backyard, the park, a creek and the woods. Swipe to turn, jump gaps, slide under nets and grab gold stars. Works on phone and computer.
games.lead: A fast endless runner with sharp corners, drawn like a page from a sketchbook. Pick your runner from eight kids, then race a path that twists left and right through five places: downtown, the backyard, the park, a creek and the woods. Swipe the way the arrow points to take each corner, jump logs and gaps, slide under nets and branches, and grab gold stars for points. Catch a paper plane to fly, a magnet to pull stars in, a bubble that saves you once, or a skateboard to zoom through anything. Every 500 meters a new wave starts: faster, with a bigger multiplier. Stars you collect add up between runs and unlock new runners.
how: Your runner races down the path on their own and gets faster the longer you last.
The path turns 90 degrees left and right. An arrow sign and a rail mark each corner: swipe that way just before you reach it. Miss it and you run into the rail.
Change lanes to get around walls, hot dog carts, lookout towers and fallen trees. Tall walls block a whole lane, so go around them.
Jump over low things like logs, sandbox castles and ducks, and over gaps in the path. Slide under branches, picnic blankets and nets.
Grab gold stars for 10 points each. You also score for every meter you run and a bonus for every corner.
Bump into something head on and the run is over. Bump the side of something and you stumble, but a second stumble soon after ends the run.
Every 500 meters is a new wave: faster, with a bigger score multiplier. Stars add up between runs: Clare unlocks at 150, George at 400, Joan at 800, then John, Catherine, Joseph and Thérèse.
controls: Computer: use the arrow keys or A and D to change lanes and turn corners, Up, W or Space to jump, and Down or S to slide. You can also drag with the mouse.
Phone or tablet: swipe left or right to change lanes, swipe up to jump and swipe down to slide.
Press P or Esc, or tap the pause button, to take a break.
The sound button turns sound on or off.
tips: Look ahead, not at your runner. Big things in the distance give you lots of time to pick a lane.
Swipe down while you're in the air to drop fast, then slide straight under the next net.
Wait until you're past something before you switch lanes, or you'll bump its side.
A paper plane lets you fly over everything and grab a line of stars in the sky.
A magnet pulls stars to you, and a bubble saves you from one bump.
about: Sketch Sprint is the game that started Sketchpad Arcade. It began as a request to redraw a runner from our sister site to look like a ten-year-old had sketched it in a notebook, and the result was so much fun that we built a whole site around the idea. It is a fast endless runner with hard 90-degree corners through downtown, the backyard, the park, a creek and the woods.

Stars carry over between runs and unlock new runners, so there is always something to work toward. Power-ups like the paper plane, magnet, bubble and skateboard change how each run feels, and every 500 meters a new wave arrives, faster and worth more. The eight kids, the scenery and the power-ups are all our own pencil art.

games.name: Doodle Drop
games.tagline: Spin a giant pencil and drop a bouncy striped ball down to the finish platform.
games.meta: Play Doodle Drop free online. Spin a giant pencil to line up gaps, bounce a striped ball down ring by ring, dodge pink scribbles and ink blots, and land on the chequered finish. Works on phone and computer.
games.lead: A bouncy striped ball sits at the top of a giant pencil, and the only way down is through the gaps in the paper rings around it. Drag to spin the pencil, drop through ring after ring, and steer clear of the spiky pink scribbles and sliding ink blots. Fall through three in a row and your ball glows with a rainbow that smashes right through the next ring.
how: The striped ball bounces up and down on its own.
Drag left or right to spin the pencil and turn a gap under the ball.
Drop through each ring to score. More rings in a row score more.
Don't land on the pink scribbles or the sliding purple ink blots.
Fall through three rings without bouncing to glow, then smash the next ring to bits.
Land on the chequered finish platform at the bottom to clear the level and climb a taller pencil.
controls: Computer: drag with the mouse, or hold the arrow keys or A and D to spin the pencil. Press Esc to pause.
Phone or tablet: drag left and right anywhere on the pencil.
The sound button turns the sound effects on or off.
tips: Start turning while the ball is still in the air so the gap is ready when it lands.
Little nudges work better than big swipes. The pencil keeps spinning a bit after you let go.
Chain drops together for big points and a rainbow smash that even breaks scribbles.
Watch the ink blots slide before you land near them.
If you pop, Retry starts the same level again with the score you had when it began.
about: Doodle Drop is a tower-falling game. A striped ball sits on top of a giant pencil ringed with paper discs, and you drag to spin the pencil so the ball can drop through the gaps. Spiky pink scribbles and sliding ink blots on the rings end your run if you land on them.

The rainbow mechanic rewards nerve: fall through three rings in a row without touching anything and the ball glows and smashes straight through the next ring, scribbles included. It is a quick game with a very satisfying rhythm once you find it.

games.name: Pencil Plunk
games.tagline: Pull thumbtacks out of popsicle sticks on a corkboard and sort them into paper cups.
games.meta: Play Pencil Plunk free online. Pull colorful thumbtacks out of popsicle sticks pinned to a corkboard, fill paper cups by color and plunk every stick onto the desk. Works on phone and computer.
games.lead: A pin-pulling puzzle on a corkboard. Popsicle sticks are pinned to the board with bright thumbtacks. Tap a tack that no stick is lying on and it pops out and flies into the paper cup of its color. Tacks with no cup wait in the pencil case, so plan ahead before it fills up. Pull the last tack from a stick and it plunks onto the desk, while a little gold star buddy cheers you on.
how: Tap a thumbtack that no popsicle stick is lying on. Tacks under a stick look darker and can't be pulled yet.
The tack flies into the paper cup of the same color. Three tacks fill a cup, and the next cup drops in.
If no cup wants that color, the tack waits in the pencil case. A new cup scoops up its color from there.
A stick with one tack left swings down, and it can cover other tacks. Pull its last tack and it plunks onto the desk.
Clear every stick to finish the level. If the pencil case is full and no tack fits a cup, the game is over.
controls: Phone or tablet: tap a tack to pull it.
Computer: click a tack. On a keyboard, the arrow keys pick a free tack, Enter or Space pulls it, and + adds a slot.
The +1 slot button adds a sixth spot to the pencil case, once per level. Restart level tries the level again.
The sound button turns sound on or off.
tips: Pull tacks that match a waiting cup first. They don't use up pencil case space.
Check the Next note at the top to see which cup colors are coming.
Look before you pull a stick's second-to-last tack. It will swing down and may cover tacks below it.
Every cup shows its tack's symbol, so you can match by shape as well as color.
Save +1 slot for when the pencil case is almost full.
about: Pencil Plunk is a pin-pulling puzzle on a corkboard. Popsicle sticks are pinned down with bright thumbtacks; tap a tack that no stick is lying on and it pops out and flies into the paper cup of its colour. When a stick loses its last tack it plunks onto the desk, and a little gold star buddy cheers.

Tacks with no cup wait in the pencil case, and if the case fills up the level is lost, so the whole game is about choosing the right order. Early boards are gentle; later ones stack sticks several deep and need a careful look before the first tap.

games.name: Draw Brawl
games.tagline: Grab gold stars, fill your fort and dodge the sprinklers against three computer rivals in a backyard brawl.
games.meta: Play Draw Brawl free online. Pick Max, Ruby or Leo, grab gold stars, bank them at your fort and splat three computer rivals before the sprinklers come on. 2-minute rounds. Works on phone and computer.
games.lead: A backyard arena full of cardboard boxes, crates and paint splats where everyone wants the same stars. Choose Max, Ruby or Leo, scoop up gold stars and carry them home to your own fort before a rival splats you. Every 25 seconds the sprinklers soak the outer lanes, so plan your route. Highest banked score after two minutes wins. You play against three computer rivals, right in your browser.
how: Pick a character. Max is a sturdy close-range brawler with a paint roller, Ruby is fast with rapid paint shots, and Leo is a tank with a cardboard-tube cannon and a box shield.
Collect the gold stars scattered around the yard. There are plenty in the middle. You can carry up to 15.
Carry them back to your own fort and stand inside its ring for a moment to bank them. Only banked stars count, and other players' forts won't take yours.
Bop rivals to splat them: they drop everything they were carrying and jump back in a few seconds later.
Get really close to a rival and a Showdown ring locks you both in for a few seconds. Splat them before the timer runs out to win bonus stars.
Watch for the sprinkler warning: water soaks the marked outer lanes and slows anyone running through it. Forts stay dry.
Highest banked score when the 2-minute timer ends wins. Ties are shared.
controls: Computer: WASD or the arrow keys move. J attacks and auto-aims at the nearest rival; hold the mouse button to aim shots yourself. Space dashes, Q uses your special, Esc pauses.
Phone or tablet: drag the left side of the screen to move. ATTACK auto-aims, or drag the AIM pad to point your shots where you want them. SPECIAL and DASH are next to it.
The pause button freezes the match. The speaker button turns sound effects on; they start muted.
tips: Bank often. Stars you're carrying are worth nothing until they're home, and a splat spills them all.
Fight rivals who are carrying a lot and let the ones with empty hands go.
Head for your fort when the sprinkler warning appears so you're not stuck in the spray.
Leo's box shield blocks every hit for a moment: pop it when two rivals close in.
Showdown wins pay 3 bonus stars, so pick fights when your health is high.
about: Draw Brawl is a two-minute backyard arena where you and three computer rivals compete for the same gold stars. You pick Max, Ruby or Leo, scoop stars and carry them home to your own cardboard fort, where they are banked and safe. Get splatted by a rival on the way and you drop what you are carrying.

Every 25 seconds the sprinklers soak the outer lanes, so the shortest route is not always the safest one. The rivals are tuned to feel like other players rather than a rigged clock, and the kids, the forts and the paint-splat arena are our own pencil art.

games.name: Doodle Darts
games.tagline: Tap at just the right moment to blast the target and nail the gold bullseye.
games.meta: Play Doodle Darts free online. A one-tap timing darts game drawn in pencil: wait for your aim to drift over the target, throw, and blow it apart. Chain gold bullseyes, dodge spiky blobs and unlock new backdrops and darts. Works on phone and computer.
games.lead: A fast one-tap darts game drawn in pencil on a sketchbook page. Your aim drifts left, right, up and down over a sketched dartboard. Tap at the right moment and your dart smashes the target to pieces, then a new one pops up somewhere else. Hit the gold star for a bullseye, build combos, and see how many doodled desk friends you can beat.
how: Watch your aim drift over the target. Tap when it's on the target to throw. Every hit is worth a point.
Hit the gold star in the middle for a Bullseye. Bullseyes in a row build a combo worth more and more points.
Miss the target and you lose a dart. You have 3. Never hit a spiky blob, or your game is over.
Smash the big bonus gold stars when they appear for extra points and coins.
controls: Tap or click anywhere on the page to throw. On a keyboard, press Space.
The turtle button slows your aim for 5 throws and the target button makes the target bigger for 5 throws. Each costs 25 coins.
Use the Shop on the start screen to spend coins on new backdrops and new things to throw, like a feather or an ice pop.
tips: Your aim speeds up as your score climbs, so save the Slowpoke power-up for later in a run.
Coins come from every hit, with bullseyes and big bonus gold stars paying the most.
Out of darts? Keep playing for 50 coins gives you one more dart, once per game.
Beat Pencil, Eraser, Crayon and the rest of the doodled desk friends on the way to the Backpack.
about: Doodle Darts is a one-tap timing game that we built to be played in short bursts. Your aim never stops moving over the target, so the whole game lives in the moment you tap. Hit near the centre and the target shatters; hit the gold spot for a bullseye and a combo boost.

A row of opponents each has a score to beat, and knocking them off one by one gives the game a sense of progress beyond the raw number. It is easy to learn in ten seconds and hard to put down, which is exactly what we were after.

games.name: Word Workshop
games.tagline: Drag across the letters to spell words and fill a sketchbook crossword.
games.meta: Play Word Workshop free online. Drag across a ring of letters to spell words, fill the crossword, find bonus words and build combos. Choose Beginner, Intermediate or Advanced across 88 levels. Works on phone and computer.
games.lead: A relaxing word puzzle drawn in pencil on a sketchbook page. Drag across the letters on the wheel to spell words, and each one you find drops into the crossword above. Fill every square to finish the level. Every real word counts: extra words earn bonus points, quick words build combos, and long words earn big rewards.
how: Drag across the letters on the wheel to spell a word, then let go.
Words that fit the crossword drop into the board. Fill every square to finish the level.
Any other real word is a Bonus Word. It earns points and fills the Bonus meter under the board, and every 6 bonus words pays 30 stickers.
Find words within a few seconds of each other to build a combo, up to 5X points. Longer words score much more.

On Beginner, after five misses in a row the first two letters of an unsolved word light up as a clue (eight misses on Intermediate, no free clues on Advanced). Solve a level without hints for 3 stars.

Pick a difficulty. Beginner has 28 relaxed levels with short words. Intermediate has 30 levels with 6 and 7 letter wheels, bigger grids and 1.5X points. Advanced has 30 levels with 7 and 8 letter wheels, only counts words of 4 or more letters, and gives you 4 minutes plus 10 seconds per grid word, for 2X points.
controls: Drag with your finger or mouse across the letters. Slide back to the previous letter to undo it.

Shuffle mixes up the letters. The lightbulb costs stickers per step (10 on Beginner, 15 on Intermediate, 25 on Advanced): first it lights up a starting letter, then the next letter, then shows the word's first letters in the grid.
The star shows your bonus words and personal bests, the bars button lets you switch difficulty or start over, and the speaker button turns sound on or off.
tips: Look for short three-letter words first. They often unlock the crossing letters for longer words.
Shuffle when you feel stuck. Seeing the letters in a new order often shows you a word right away.
Try every word you can see. Real words that don't fit the grid still earn bonus points and fill the Bonus meter.
The level's name is always one of the answers, and it uses every letter on the wheel.
about: Word Workshop is a letter-wheel crossword game. Each level gives you a handful of letters on a wheel and a small crossword above it; drag across letters to spell words, and the ones in the puzzle drop into place. Any real word you find counts, so extra words still earn points.
We tuned it so that a quick player and a thorough player both have fun: combos reward speed, and long words earn a bonus. Levels are saved on your device, and the word list is family-friendly.

games.name: Bubble Doodle
games.tagline: Aim, bounce and pop bubbles before they reach the dashed line.
games.meta: Play Bubble Doodle free online. Aim with a dotted pencil guide line, bank shots off the walls and pop matching bubbles before they reach the dashed line. Works on phone and computer.
games.lead: A bubble shooter drawn in coloured pencil, with a dotted aim line. Bounce shots off the walls, pop bubbles of the same color and knock loose whole clusters before the rows reach the dashed line.
how: Drag to aim. The dotted pencil line shows exactly where your shot will go, including bounces off the walls.
Release to shoot. Hitting a bubble of the same color pops the whole connected group.
Bubbles left hanging with nothing above them fall off for bonus points.
Pop every bubble to clear the level. Each level only sends a few new rows, so the board can be beaten, and each level adds rows and colors. The game ends if bubbles cross the red dashed line.
controls: Drag and release with a mouse or finger to aim and shoot.
Tap the waiting bubble to swap it with your current one.
On a keyboard, use the arrow keys to aim and Space to shoot.
Every 6 pops charges a bomb that clears everything around where it lands.
tips: Bank shots off the walls to reach gaps you can't hit directly.
Dropping a big hanging cluster is worth far more than popping.
Watch the new-row counter and clear the lowest rows first.
about: Bubble Doodle is Sketchpad Arcade's bubble shooter. The dotted aim line shows exactly where your shot will land, including after a bounce off the wall, which makes the game friendly for younger players while still rewarding the tricky bank shots older players like to set up.

Popping a group of three or more clears it, but the real points come from the bubbles left hanging underneath, which drop away in a cascade. The rows creep down a little at a time, so there is always a reason to plan two or three shots ahead.

games.name: Four in a Frame
games.tagline: Sort sixteen words into four secret groups of four.
games.meta: Play Four in a Frame free online. Sort sixteen word tiles on a corkboard into four secret groups of four. Play a new Daily Puzzle every day, or pick Beginner, Intermediate or Advanced. Works on phone and computer.
games.lead: A word-sorting puzzle for the whole family. Sixteen paper word tiles are pinned to a corkboard, and they hide four secret groups of four. Tap four that belong together and check your guess. Groups start easy, like fruits and colours, and get sneakier as you go, with words that seem to fit two groups at once.
how: Tap four words you think belong together, then tap Check.
Get it right and the group lifts to the top in its colour. Yellow groups are the easiest and pink groups are the trickiest.
If you're one word off, it tells you you're one away. Run out of tries and the groups are shown, and you lose a star. Lose all 3 stars and the game ends.

Pick a level. Beginner has simple groups with 5 tries and 2 hints per puzzle. Intermediate adds wordplay like SUN___ with 4 tries, 1 hint and 1.5X points. Advanced is full of red herrings, with 3 tries, no hints and 2X points. Each level remembers where you got to.

Play the Daily Puzzle from the yellow Daily button. Everyone gets the same puzzle that day, the clock only runs while you're playing, and solving one each day builds your streak. Share your result to challenge friends.
Each group you find scores points, plus a bonus for every try you had left.
controls: Tap or click a word to pick it, and tap it again to put it back.
Shuffle mixes up the words, Clear unpicks them, and Hint lights up two words that go together.
On a keyboard, press Enter to check and Escape to clear.
The Sound button turns sound on or off.
tips: Find the easiest group first. Fewer words left makes the tricky groups easier to spot.
If a word fits two groups, save it for last and work out which group needs it.
Some groups are word puzzles, like words that go before BOOK or words that sound like letters.
Use Shuffle when you feel stuck. Seeing the words in a new order often helps.
about: Four in a Frame is a word-grouping puzzle. Sixteen words hide four groups of four; your job is to find the groups. Some are obvious, like animals or colours, and some are sneaky, with words that seem to belong in two groups at once or groups that are really word puzzles in disguise.

We wrote it for the whole family to play together on one screen, calling out guesses. Each puzzle is hand-built rather than random, so the tricky ones are tricky on purpose, and the easy groups give younger players a way in.

games.name: Margin Match
games.tagline: Tap doodle tiles off the pile and collect three of a kind in your tray.
games.meta: Play Margin Match free online. Tap pencil, scissors, star and other doodle tiles off a stacked pile, collect three of a kind in your 7-spot tray and clear the whole pile to win each level. Works on phone and computer.
games.lead: A cheerful tile-matching puzzle piled high with sketchbook doodles. Tap a tile and it hops into your tray. Collect three of the same, like three pencils or three paperclips, and they clear away. Clear the whole pile to win the level, but don't let your 7-spot tray fill up.
how: Tap any bright tile on the pile to move it into your tray at the bottom.
Get three of the same doodle in the tray and they clear away for points. Clear trios quickly one after another for a combo.
Dark tiles are covered by tiles on top. Clear the tiles above them first.
Clear every tile from the pile to finish the level. If all 7 tray spots fill up without a trio, the level is over and you can try it again.
Each level has more tiles, more kinds of doodles and taller stacks.
controls: Tap or click a tile to move it to the tray.

Undo puts your last tile back on the pile. Lift moves 3 tiles from your tray up to a holding spot, and you can tap them back in later. Shuffle mixes up the doodles on the pile. You get one of each every level.
The ? button shows the rules and lets you continue from your last level or start a new game.
tips: Before you tap, look at what's already in your tray and pick a tile that matches it.
Uncover the tall stacks early so the dark tiles don't trap you at the end.
Save Lift for when your tray has 5 or 6 tiles. It frees up room right away.
Your level is saved, so you can come back later and carry on.
about: Margin Match is a tile-matching puzzle in the style of the popular triple-match games, piled high with sketchbook doodles. Tiles are stacked in overlapping layers, and only tiles with nothing on top can be picked. Tap one and it hops into a seven-slot tray; collect three of a kind and they clear.

Clearing the whole pile with a seven-slot tray takes a little planning, because grabbing two of something you cannot finish is the fastest way to run out of room. The pencils, paperclips and other doodles are our own drawings, and your level is saved so you can come back to it.

games.name: No. 2 Pencil
games.tagline: Link matching classroom doodles before the timer runs out.
games.meta: Play No. 2 Pencil free online. Tap pencil-sketched classroom tiles to colour them in, connect matching pairs with a path of up to two turns and clear the desk before time runs out. Works on phone and computer.
games.lead: A tile-matching puzzle drawn in plain No. 2 pencil. Every tile is a classroom doodle, like an apple, a globe, a school bus or a trophy, and it colours in when you tap it. Connect two matching tiles with a path of no more than two turns and clear the whole desk before the timer runs out.
how: Tap a tile to select it and it colours in.
Tap a matching tile. If a path with no more than two turns joins them, both tiles clear.
Paths can run around the outside edge of the board, but not through other tiles or blocked squares.
Clear every tile before the timer empties to finish the level. Each match adds a second back.
controls: Tap or click a tile to select it, and tap it again to deselect.
Hint (or the H key) highlights a pair you can match. You get 3 per level.
Shuffle (or the S key) mixes the board. You get 2 per level.
The Sound button mutes all sound effects.
tips: Linking tiles that are far apart earns more stars.
Matching quickly builds a combo multiplier up to x5.
From level 4, tiles slide after each match, so think one move ahead.
Save your hints for the bigger boards.
about: No. 2 Pencil is our take on the classic tile-connecting puzzle, sometimes called a link-link or mahjong-connect game, drawn entirely in plain pencil. Every tile is a classroom doodle, an apple, a globe, a school bus, a trophy, and it colours in when you tap it. Two matching tiles clear if a path with no more than two turns joins them.

We built it with a short timer and a quick restart so it works as well in a two-minute wait as in a longer sitting. From level 4 the tiles slide after each match, which turns a relaxed game into a sharper one, and linking tiles that are far apart earns extra stars.

games.name: Scribble Blocks
games.tagline: Drag shapes onto the board and clear rows and columns.
games.meta: Play Scribble Blocks free online. Drag coloured-pencil block shapes onto an 8x8 grid, fill rows and columns to rub them out, and chain combos for big scores. Works on phone and computer.
games.lead: A relaxing block puzzle with bright coloured-pencil pieces outlined in black. Place shapes on an 8x8 grid, fill a row or column to rub it out and chain clears together for big combos. Gold star blocks are worth bonus points.
how: Drag a piece from the tray onto the board.
Fill a whole row or column to clear it. Lines that are about to clear light up before you drop.
Place all three pieces to get three new ones.
The game ends when none of your pieces fit anywhere. Pieces that can't fit turn gray.
controls: Drag and drop pieces with a mouse or finger.
Undo takes back your last move. You get 3 per game.
New game starts over at any time.
tips: Keep the middle of the board open for the big square pieces.
Avoid leaving single empty cells that only a 1x1 piece can fill.
Clearing several lines at once, or on back-to-back moves, multiplies your score.
about: Scribble Blocks is a block-placing puzzle with bright coloured-pencil pieces outlined in black. You get three pieces at a time, place them anywhere on the 8x8 grid, and rub out full rows or columns. There is no timer and no falling pieces, so it suits players who like to think before they move.

The twist is the gold stars. Some pieces carry star blocks that are worth +25 when they clear, and the game ends only when none of your three pieces fit. Learning to keep a corner open for the long bar is the difference between a short game and a very long one.

games.name: Drop Swap
games.tagline: Swap classroom doodles, match three and clear the scribbles.
games.meta: Play Drop Swap free online. Swap apples, pencils, books, backpacks, crayons and star stickers to match three in a row, build power-ups and beat 30 levels. Works on phone and computer.
games.lead: A bright match-3 puzzle with 30 levels, drawn in coloured pencil. Swap neighboring tiles to line up three or more apples, pencils, books, backpacks, crayons or star stickers. Each level has its own goal and a limited number of moves, and your stars decorate your classroom.
how: Swap two neighboring tiles to line up three or more of the same kind.
Finish the level's goals before you run out of moves. Some levels ask you to collect certain tiles, and others ask you to clear every scribble.
Scribbles clear when you make a match on top of them. Darker scribbles take two matches.
Moves you have left at the end turn into bonus points and can earn you up to 3 stars.
controls: Drag a tile toward its neighbor to swap them, or tap one tile and then the tile next to it.
Levels lets you replay any level you have unlocked.
Restart level starts the current level over.
The Sound button turns sound effects on or off.
tips: Match 4 in a line to make a ruler that clears a whole row or column.
Make an L or T shape to make scissors that snip the tiles around them.
Match 5 in a line to make a paint palette. Swap it with any tile to clear every tile of that kind.
Wait a few seconds and two tiles will pulse to show you a move.
about: Drop Swap is a 30-level match-3 puzzle with a different goal on every board, drawn in coloured pencil with classroom tiles: apples, pencils, books, backpacks, crayons and star stickers. Each level gives you a fixed number of moves, so it rewards planning over fast swiping.

Lining up four or five tiles makes special pieces, a ruler that clears a line, scissors that snip the tiles around them, a paint palette that clears every tile of one kind. The stars you earn decorate your classroom, and progress is saved on your device.

games.name: Pencil Path
games.tagline: Tap pencils to send them off the notepad, one clear path at a time.
games.meta: Play Pencil Path free online. Tap coloured pencils to send them sliding off a lined notepad, but only when their path is clear. 60 levels of relaxing logic puzzles. Works on phone and computer.
games.lead: A calm logic puzzle on a lined notepad. Each pencil slides straight the way its tip is pointing, so tap the ones with a clear path off the page first and open the way for the rest. Bump into another pencil and you lose a heart.
how: Tap a pencil to send it sliding straight the way its tip points.
It only gets off the page if nothing is in its way. If it bumps another pencil, you lose one of your 3 hearts.
Every pencil that leaves opens a path for others. Clear the whole page to finish the level.
Ink blots appear in later levels. They never move, but every pencil can still get off the page.
controls: Tap or click a pencil to send it off the page.
Hint glows on a pencil that can leave safely. You get 3 per level.
Restart level starts the page over, and Levels lets you replay any level you've unlocked.
tips: Start with pencils on the edges pointing out. They always have a clear path.
Before tapping, trace the pencil's line all the way to the edge of the page.
Finish without any bumps to earn all 3 stars.
about: Pencil Path is a gentle logic puzzle on a lined notepad. Each pencil slides straight the way its tip is pointing, so the whole puzzle is about order: which pencil can slide off the page right now, and which ones are blocking each other.

There is no time limit. You can study the page as long as you like, but you only have a few hearts, and every bump costs one. Early pages have a handful of pencils; later ones pack the paper with crisscrossing lines that take real thought to untangle, and a clean solve earns all three stars.

games.name: Space Blaster
games.tagline: Fly a little rocket and blast the UFOs swooping down from space.
games.meta: Play Space Blaster free online. Steer a little rocket across grid-paper space and zap saucers, dome UFOs, ring ships, triangle ships and a shielded mothership in this retro arcade shooter, with every level harder than the last. Works on phone and computer.
games.lead: A retro arcade shooter drawn on grid paper. UFOs of every shape and size, from tiny scouts to a shielded mothership, line up in formation and swoop down at your little rocket. Fire rapid laser bolts to zap them, dodge their alien goo, and see how many levels you can clear.
how: Hold and drag to steer your rocket along the bottom of the page. It fires a rapid stream of lasers while you hold.
Each hit zaps a UFO. The big mothership has a shield and takes two hits.
UFOs swoop down at you and drop alien goo. Get bumped or gooed and you lose a ship. You start with 3.
Clear every UFO to finish the level. Each level they swoop faster, dive more often and drop more goo.
controls: Hold and drag on the screen to steer and fire. With a mouse, move to steer and hold the button down to fire.
On a keyboard, use the arrow keys or A and D to move, Space to fire and P to pause.
Pause stops the action, and the Sound button turns sound effects on or off.
tips: UFOs are worth double while they're diving, so stay brave.
Your lasers fire a little faster every level and come out in two streams from level 5.
Zap the power star for 12 seconds of an extra laser stream.
Watch for goo and slide out of the way. It falls toward where you were.
You earn an extra ship at 20,000 points and again at 70,000.
about: Space Blaster is a nod to the fixed-screen arcade shooters of the early 1980s, drawn on grid paper. UFOs of every shape and size line up in formation and then peel off to dive at your little rocket, and you answer with rapid laser bolts while dodging their alien goo.

Each level adds faster dives and a shielded mothership to crack, and your lasers get a little quicker as you go. It is a game of pattern reading: learn when each UFO breaks formation and you can clear whole squadrons without a scratch, and diving UFOs are worth double for the brave.

games.name: Space Glass
games.tagline: Colour space pictures by number, one pencil colour at a time.
games.meta: Play Space Glass free online. A relaxing color-by-number puzzle on grid paper: pick a color, tap or drag across the matching numbers and fill detailed pixel pictures of rockets, astronauts, UFOs, planets and galaxies. Works on phone and computer.
games.lead: A relaxing color-by-number puzzle on a sheet of grid paper. Each level is a detailed pixel picture from outer space, like a rocket, an astronaut, a UFO, a ringed planet or a galaxy. Pick a numbered color, then tap or drag across the matching squares and zoom in for the small details.
how: Pick a coloured pencil from the tray at the bottom. Every square with its number lights up on the picture.
Tap a lit square to color it in, or hold and drag across several at once. Zoom in with + or a pinch for small squares.
When a color is finished it gets a check mark and the next color is picked for you.
Fill every square to finish the picture and move on to the next level.
controls: Tap or click a square to fill it. Hold and drag to fill a whole row in one go.
Tap a color in the tray to switch, or press 1 to 9 on a keyboard.
The magnifier points out a square you missed, and the Sound button turns sound effects on or off.
tips: Dragging is the fastest way to fill big areas. Squares of other colors are skipped, so you can sweep right over them.
The small number on each color shows how many squares are left.
Tap a square with a different number and the game shows you which color it needs.
Finished pictures are saved in the Pictures collection on the start screen.
about: Space Glass is a colour-by-number puzzle on grid paper. Every level is a detailed pixel picture from outer space, a rocket, an astronaut, a UFO, a ringed planet, a galaxy, and you fill it in by picking a numbered colour and tapping or dragging across the matching squares, zooming in for the small details.

It is one of the calmest games on the site and a favourite for anyone who likes to wind down. Dragging skips squares of other colours, so big areas go fast, and finished pictures stay in your collection on your device so you can look back at them.

games.name: Chibi Chib
games.tagline: Pick up scrambled gems and put each colour back to rebuild cute chibi animals.
games.meta: Play Chibi Chib free online. A relaxing gem sorting puzzle: tap misplaced gems to pick them up with their neighbours, then stash them in the tray or drop them onto their coloured squares to finish 17 detailed chibi animal pictures. Works on phone and computer.
games.lead: A calm, colourful sorting puzzle starring big-eyed chibi animals. Every picture starts scrambled, with gems sitting on squares of the wrong colour. Each square shows the colour it wants, so zoom in, pick up gems and drop them where they belong until the kitty, puppy, panda, fox and friends are complete.
how: Each square shows the colour it wants with a small coloured dot. Every gem starts on a square of the wrong colour.
Tap a misplaced gem to pick up its little patch of matching gems. Tap it again to put them back down.
Tap the tray to stash the gems you're holding, or tap an open square of their colour to drop them straight into the picture.
Fill every square to finish the picture. The pictures get bigger and more detailed as you go.
controls: Tap or click gems, the tray, tray colours and squares.
Pinch, scroll the mouse wheel or use the + and − buttons to zoom. Drag to move around, and double-tap to zoom in or out.
Hint (10 coins) shows a good move, +1 Row (30 coins) adds 16 tray spots, and Undo (15 coins) takes back your last move.
tips: Before stashing gems in the tray, check whether there's already an open square of their colour you can drop them on.
Zoom in on busy spots so it's easier to tap exactly the square you want.
Finish a picture without boosters for 5 bonus coins.
Finished pictures are saved in My pictures on the start screen.
about: Chibi Chib is a sorting puzzle starring big-eyed chibi animals. Every picture starts scrambled, with gems sitting on squares of the wrong colour, and each square shows the colour it wants. You pick up gems and drop them where they belong until the kitty, puppy, panda, fox and friends are complete.

The small tray is the whole strategy. It has only a few slots, so you cannot simply scoop everything up; you have to plan a route that frees the right squares in the right order. Finish a picture without boosters for bonus coins, and finished pictures are saved in My Pictures.

games.name: Word Scribble
games.tagline: Drop letter bubbles into a pencil box, merge matching letters and swipe to spell words.
games.meta: Play Word Scribble free online. Drop letter bubbles into a wooden pencil box, merge matching letters into bigger ones, and swipe across nearby bubbles to spell words. Works on phone and computer.
games.lead: A merge game and a word game in one pencil box. Letters drop in color-coded sets that each spell a hidden word, and when two of the same letter touch they merge into a bigger letter worth more points. Swipe across nearby bubbles to spell words, which pops them and makes room for more. Spell enough words to clear the level before the box fills up.
how: Tap or drag above the bubbles, then let go to drop a letter into the pencil box. Every letter of a hidden word drops in the same color, so matching colors can be unscrambled into a word.

When two of the same letter touch, in any color, they merge into a bigger silver letter worth double, then a gold one worth triple. Silver and gold letters fit any word, and two gold letters make a wild gold star that can stand for any letter.

Swipe across bubbles in order to spell one of the hidden words. They don't have to touch, just be close together. A hidden word pops, frees up room and counts toward the level, and spelled in a single color it scores double.
Any other real word of three or more letters is a Bonus Word: it earns bonus points and the letters stay in the box. Each bonus word counts once per level.
Spell the number of hidden words shown at the top to clear the level. The star word counts double, pays a big bonus and starts Star Mode.
The game ends if the bubbles stay above the dotted line.
controls: Start a swipe on a bubble to spell. Slide back to the previous bubble to undo a letter.
Start anywhere else to aim, then let go to drop. On a keyboard, use the arrow keys and Space.
Pop removes one bubble you choose. You get another Pop each level.
tips: Drop each color's letters close together so you can swipe its hidden word in one go for double points.
Keep vowels spread around the box so every group of letters has something to spell with.
Longer words score much more than short ones, so build up before you cash in.
Save your wild gold star for the star word or a long word.
about: Word Scribble mixes two things we love, merge games and word games, in a single pencil box. Letters fall in colour-coded groups that each spell a hidden word, and matching letters that touch merge into a bigger letter worth more points. You clear space by swiping across nearby letters to spell words.

The tension comes from the fill line. Spell enough words and the level clears; let the box fill and the game ends. It rewards both vocabulary and a sharp eye for where the next letter will land, and the word list is family-friendly.
